unit.why: A single tale of R. Pinhas of Korets healing a young consumptive after other tzaddikim had failed, with his own explanation of how he succeeded.

stories.start_quote: בס׳ באה״מ (דף כ׳) כי פ"א בא
stories.end_quote: להסכים עמי גם בשער הרפואה עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: A young man with consumption, whom many tzaddikim could not help, is healed through R. Pinhas of Korets's blessing. R. Pinhas explains that he 'tunneled' through the gate of livelihood and then used the talmudic principle that whoever is given sustenance is given life to force the gate of healing open.
